text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: *Gasp*, *pant*, *pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"This is... really working my legs...
But it feels like I'm digging in with a solid stride."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I must master this run...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: One more lap...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: TOAAAAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-san.
Forgive me for speaking out of turn, but
is everything all right over there...?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Whether she's relying purely on brute force or just tensing up too much...
that running style really doesn't look like Satono-san."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With the Tenno Sho (Autumn) against Mejiro McQueen and overseas races in mind, we began training to build powerful running form.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, an unexpected trend began to emerge.
Satono Diamond's running form started to fall apart.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her running form looks disjointed,
as if her power isn't translating smoothly.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
The beach sand might be the cause,
so hopefully it's only temporary.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hope it's just as Ikuno Dictus says, but...
In any case, let's wait and see for a bit.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And just like that,
the final day of the summer training camp had arrived.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Kita-chan, let's sit next to each other on the bus♪

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I already put my stuff at our seats!
Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? Dia-chan?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: She fell asleep...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Mnh... Gotta get stronger...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Fufu, you worked so hard during the training camp, after all.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...Good night, Dia-chan.
